entities.name: PMID:25093233
observations: McCrae et al. (2014) analyzed older adults in VA inpatient post-acute rehabilitation with actigraphy and MMSE during rehabilitation and 6 months after discharge.

entities.name: Reduced daytime sleep and cognition
observations: Among 192 older adults (mean age 73.8), decrease in actigraphy-measured daytime sleep over follow-up was associated with MMSE improvement in adjusted models (β=-0.01, t(80)=-3.22, P=.002); observational association does not establish that nap reduction causes improvement.
Daytime sleep was observed, not experimentally reduced; residual confounding and incomplete follow-up limit causal interpretation.
